newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Hyundai Motor May vehicle sales rise.
newsitem.headline: Hyundai Motor May vehicle sales rise.

text.p: Hyundai Motor Co, South Korea's largest carmaker, said on Monday its May vehicle sales rose to 117,775 units from 113,102 a year earlier.
Hyundai's vehicle exports in the month totalled 57,130 units, up from 45,437 units, while domestic sales amounted to 60,645 units, against 67,665 units.
"We have reinforced overseas marketing and after-sales services to compensate for falling domestic sales," said a Hyundai spokesman.
Domestic sales were dampened because of an economic slowdown and rival Daewoo's introduction of new model cars.
Since last November, Daewoo has introduced Lanos sub-compact, Nubira compact and Leganza mid-sized sedans.
